Metadata.title: Manasbal — a demo marketplace
Metadata.description: A portfolio demo of a multi-vendor marketplace. Nothing here is for sale; payments and delivery are simulated.

Frame.demoHeading: Demo store: nothing here is for sale.
Frame.demoDetail: Orders, payments and deliveries are simulated, so please don't enter real details.
Frame.smallPrint: Manasbal is a portfolio demo: nothing here is for sale, and payments and delivery are simulated.

Home.title: Welcome to Manasbal
Home.tagline: A demo marketplace of small, made-up stores. Look around as much as you like: nothing here is for sale.
Home.productsHeading: A few products to start with
